system.description: Sacrifice a big toe (one level of lethal damage) and burn it, smearing the ashes on hands and feet. For the next hour, make a Simple Test for each level of aggravated fire damage taken; a win or tie converts that damage to lethal. Can be cast on willing subjects up to a number equal to the caster's Mental Traits, each sacrificing a toe; losing a big toe permanently inflicts the Negative Trait Clumsy.
